decision.trend: Researchers have been exploring various methods to reduce the sintering temperature of high-entropy alloys, including mechanical alloying, spark plasma sintering, and laser powder bed fusion. The trend shows that these methods can effectively reduce the sintering temperature while maintaining or improving the mechanical properties of the alloys.
decision.unsolved: The high sintering temperature of high-entropy alloys remains a significant challenge, and further research is needed to develop more efficient and cost-effective methods to reduce the sintering temperature.
decision.why: Laser powder bed fusion has shown promise in reducing the sintering temperature of high-entropy alloys while maintaining their mechanical properties. This method allows for precise control over the processing parameters, which can help optimize the microstructure and properties of the alloy. Therefore, exploring the use of laser powder bed fusion as a new measurement method to reduce the sintering temperature of high-entropy alloys is a plausible next step.
